title: AI-assisted preparation prompts
body: Tool-agnostic prompts. AI drafts; a named human reviews facts, sharing, and capability claims before anything is used or sent.

lines.label: Authorized inputs
lines.text: Reviewed hypothesis, pre-work, stakeholder roles and session duration.

lines.label: Prompt
lines.text: Produce an outcome-led run-of-show with exact segment minutes, open diagnostic questions, note-taking roles and capture fields. Use existing customer use cases if supplied; otherwise provide clearly labeled thought starters. Preserve prioritization, owner decisions and next steps. List prerequisites that block the session.

lines.label: Required output
lines.text: Agenda; questions; capture template; readiness exceptions.

lines.label: Human review
lines.text: Facilitator reviews timing, non-leading wording and accessibility.
